policy: Upstream repositories are pinned by full commit SHA and never copied. The only upstream logic in this repository is in spark_membrane/engines/ and spark_membrane/frames.py: small, labelled reference re-implementations that are tested against outputs of the pinned upstream code (tests/fixtures/upstream_reference.json) and, in CI, live against checkouts of these exact commits.

repositories.name: oes32-residual
repositories.role: Normative OES-32 residual (ADR-001): R = max_i |y_i - x_i|, fail iff R > tolerance.
repositories.note: Pinned at the ADR-001 normative commit, not HEAD. src/, residual_definition.md and failure_criterion.md are byte-identical between b77b612 and HEAD 7277e0f; later commits are docs, CI, licence and citation metadata.
repositories.doi_note: concept DOI (all versions), from the repository's CITATION.cff

repositories.name: oes32_engine
repositories.role: Profile A sidecar: SAFE = A and C0 and C1 and Cfold (coherence, EVEN/ODD symmetry, FOLD8 continuity); LATCH = not SAFE.
